objective: Keep large new-dataset uploads visibly responsive and cancellable during transfer.

behavior.progress: computable upload bytes shown as an integer percentage
behavior.post_transfer_state: explicitly says that server validation and file-list commit are in progress
behavior.cancel_result: request aborted, file list refreshed, atomic backend batch contract retained
behavior.network_error: explicit retry message; incomplete batch is not registered

automated_acceptance.cancel_error: 已取消上传；未完成批次不会写入文件列表

limitations: Cancellation is offered while bytes are still transferring; after the browser reports 100%, the control is hidden because server-side atomic validation may already be running.
No test data was uploaded into the formal file library during browser acceptance.
This is interaction reliability, not new-dataset model accuracy evidence.
